photos.desc: Microscopic image of preserved cross-section of Hibiscus sabdariffa stem stained with fastgreen and safranin observed at 100x magnification under a microscope.
Hibiscus sabdariffa is a species of Hibiscus, an annual or perennial herb or woody-based subshrub, growing to 2–2.5 m (7–8 ft) tall.
